About Me

I am currently working as a Project Associate at SPRING Lab, IIT Madras, focusing on Text-to-Speech (TTS) for low-resource Indian languages and voice conversion, under the mentorship of Prof. S. Umesh.

Research Areas: Speech and Audio AI: Text-to-Speech (TTS), Voice Conversion (VC), Targeted Sound Detection (TSD), Audio Captioning (AAC)

Experience
  • SPRING Lab, IIT Madras
    Project Associate (Onsite)
    October 2025 - Present

    I am working under the guidance of Prof. S. Umesh on multilingual and low-resource Text-to-Speech (TTS) and Voice Conversion systems. Responsibilities include developing and optimizing diffusion-based TTS models for Indian languages as part of the Speech Technologies in Indian Languages project, analyzing and modifying the F5-TTS architecture for low-resource multilingual adaptation, and focusing on improving duration modeling, alignment stability, and overall system performance.

  • Speech Information Processing Lab, IIT Hyderabad
    Research Intern (Onsite)
    May 2024 - Aug 2025

    Worked on robust audio projects at the Speech Information Processing Lab, including Autotagging and Automatic Audio Captioning (AAC), aiming to enhance system performance and accuracy under the mentorship of Prof. K Sri Rama Murty. Designed and implemented real-time inference pipelines, optimizing deployment on ROS using Jetson Orin to ensure efficient and low-latency performance in practical applications. Focused on end-to-end system deployment, including testing, monitoring, and optimization of audio models, ensuring scalability and robustness for real-world scenarios.

  • IIM Kozhikode
    Datascience Intern (Remote)
    May 2024 - June 2024

    Collected and preprocessed data from diverse online sources through web scraping, ensuring high accuracy and reliability for academic research under the guidance of Prof. Salman. Applied advanced data analysis techniques to identify underlying patterns, and utilized regression analysis to generate actionable insights, contributing meaningfully to research outcomes and academic advancements.

  • Study Comrade
    Data Analytics Mentor (hybrid)
    Sep 2022 - Jan 2024

    Worked as a hybrid team member at Study Comrade, an edtech startup incubated at IIIT RKV, while pursuing undergraduate studies. Mentored students in data analytics and front-end technology projects, providing guidance, doubt-clearing sessions, and hands-on project support. Managed student batches, maintained the platform's website for smooth functionality, and leveraged analytics to enhance learning outcomes, gaining valuable startup and remote work experience.

Industry Sponsored Projects
Improving Eye Lens Quality Control with AI

Company: Ben Franklin (Eyegear Optics India Private Limited)

Funding: 3 Lakh INR

Team: Arigala Adarsh, Sunil Yadav, Gurudarpan Yadav

Worked on computer vision and deep learning to automate the detection of defective circular eye lenses during manufacturing. The lenses were divided into three zones, and segmentation techniques were used to crop and analyze each zone individually. Developed AI models to identify scratches, cracks, and other imperfections, improving quality control and reducing human error. Successfully deployed the solution in the company’s production plant, enabling real-time defect detection and streamlining the quality assurance process.
